purpose: Bounded primary-reference audit for a human NPC multicomponent demo

component_notes.Nup96: SNAP-AF647 reference in every dual-color acquisition
component_notes.WGA: Wheat germ agglutinin stain; not an individual nucleoporin or invented protein component

paper.figure_caption_filename_discrepancy: Fig4 caption names CF680 for Elys and Nup133, whereas official archived filenames name CF660C. Preserve original filenames and do not infer dye substitutions.
paper.reference_registration: Only Nup96 localizations were fitted at each site; fitted pose transforms register the corresponding target localizations into a common NPC model frame. The five partner acquisitions are independent samples sharing Nup96, not a simultaneous six-color particle.

coordinates.frame: Cell/acquisition frame; not already a common averaged NPC frame

csv_schema.layer_semantics: SMAP visible filtered/render layer index. export_coordinates assigns layer=k when exporting multiple visible layers; it is not a universal protein or camera-channel identifier.
csv_schema.ratiometric_semantics: A blink's fluorophore/color is assigned using its intensities in two camera channels. SMAP Intensity2ManyChannels writes color assignment to loc.channel from intensity ROI polygons. Render layers select these channel values independently; channel number is dataset/settings dependent.
csv_schema.group_semantics: SMAP SiteExplorer ROI ID, not molecule groupindex or a row-wise correspondence. Sitenumbers2loc initializes IDs to 0 and assigns sites(k).ID within each file's ROI.
csv_schema.zero_group_semantics: Unassigned to an exported site. Keep raw rows; no valid site-specific pose can be transferred without additional association.
csv_schema.group_namespace: (source filename, nonzero sitenumbers); numeric IDs can collide across independent cell files
csv_schema.precision_filters: Existing export selections differ across layers/datasets; do not silently enforce new thresholds or use distributions to replace metadata evidence.
csv_schema.heterogeneous_source_note: Archive CSV sources use render layer selections. The Nup62 same-MAT derived source uses the actual original channel column, ref2/target1; see its header and per-axis uncertainty schema.

procedure: Select verified reference and target layers separately, keeping all selected rows and original coordinates/precision.
Group within each source acquisition using the same nonzero sitenumbers. Keep references and targets in the same acquisition coordinate frame.

Fit each reference particle using only its Nup96 localizations, then transfer the exact same rigid pose, registration convention, and chosen symmetry branch to every localization of its paired target.
Use the shared reference model frame to combine separate partner datasets. Never join unrelated cells by bare numeric site ID.
Retain raw target-only/unassigned groups and report their inability to receive a reference pose; do not invent target fits, apply a target radial mask, or pretend these are registered.
Render Nup96 and each verified measured partner with host-selected distinct CML colors after registration. WGA remains named WGA.
registration_handoff.symmetry: Nup96's symmetry makes absolute azimuth ambiguous; resolve or choose a branch using the reference and transfer it consistently to the paired target. Target data must not select an independent branch.
registration_handoff.calibration: The paper derives 3D coordinates from bead-calibrated PSFs and performs temporal grouping/drift correction. The CSV provides one nm coordinate triplet per row, not two raw camera coordinates. MAT metadata includes a transformation object, but CSVs omit its coefficients, bead calibration, and residuals. Treat within-file reference/target coordinates as sharing the exported acquisition frame; numerical chromatic/axial calibration quality was not independently reconstructed here. Do not apply a second camera or z correction without verifying its provenance.
registration_handoff.site_counts_are_not_paper_acceptance_cou: Per-cell nonzero exported site counts include IDs before final fit-quality selection; paper caption totals cover three cells and final accepted sites.
registration_handoff.Nup62_pairing: Same original MAT loc table/class namespace for both raw channels; no grouped/raw mixture or nearest-site exclusion. Preserve all assigned valid raw rows. Target-only IDs603/723 cannot receive a reference pose.

readiness.leader_next_step: Use demo_sources.Nup62 source with selection_column='channel', reference_layer=2,target_layer=1. Fit raw Nup96 only, transfer by original sitenumbers. Native consumer computes maps/preset; production IO can port or invoke the first-use range contract.

source_evidence: export_coordinates.m: visible export loops render layers and labels them k independently of loc.channel.
LocalizationData.m: layer stores filters; channels and layer are separate getloc selectors.
Intensity2ManyChannels.m: uses intensities in both camera channels and assigns loc.channel from ROI indices.
Sitenumbers2loc.m: assigns file-associated SiteExplorer IDs, with 0 for unassigned rows.
fourColorNPC.md: color assignment, per-reference-model alignment, then multi-dataset reconstruction.
Archived Elys/Nup133/Nup153 NPC model settings select only Layer1.
Archived MAT selectors: Elys/Nup133/Nup153/WGA 2/1; Nup62 cell3 2/2; Nup62 cells1/2 2/[0,1].
Nup62 cells1/2 NPCPointModel_flexible2 models fit Layer1 only. Layers share the driftc_filter_xMirrored_fit1_zc source file and zero additional XYZ shifts.
SMAP channel filters use equality-list membership. Intensity2ManyChannels initializes channel=0, then assigns intensity-polygon indices; 0 means unassigned.
